cases.customer_question: What qualification risk exists if required Bluetooth PTS reports are missing from the review package or shared repository?
question_variants: Missing PTS report in review folder
DIS report missing from Teams share
How to manage missing profile reports during review?
cases.actual_issue: Required Bluetooth PTS reports for BAS and DIS were not uploaded to the shared review repository even though other profile reports were present.
cases.plain_english_explanation: A qualification review package must contain all required Bluetooth profile reports before approval. In this thread, only HIDS and HOGP reports were initially available, while BAS and DIS reports were missing from the shared folder. The consultant halted approval until the missing reports were uploaded and reviewed.
cases.consultant_answer: The consultant confirmed that the revised overall profile report looked acceptable but identified that the BAS and DIS PTS reports were missing from the shared Teams folder. The consultant instructed the engineer to upload the revised BAS and DIS reports and request approval afterward. The engineer later confirmed that the missing reports had been uploaded.
cases.decision_logic: Bluetooth qualification review requires complete supporting evidence for all tested profiles. Missing PTS reports prevent complete verification of qualification coverage and block approval readiness.
cases.final_recommendation: Ensure all required Bluetooth profile PTS reports are uploaded, accessible, and reviewed together before requesting final qualification approval.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: Missing reports can delay qualification approval, create incomplete audit evidence, and require repeated review cycles or administrative rework.
